nodes.summary: `configWeight` is the product weight `StatMech.pweight` for Bernoulli coordinate weights.
nodes.title: Configuration weight as a product weight

nodes.summary: The product weight splits as the weight of `e` times the weight of the other coordinates.
nodes.title: Configuration weight splits at one coordinate

nodes.summary: The product weight `configWeight p ω` is nonnegative for `p ∈ [0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the configuration weight

nodes.summary: The product weight `∏ e, edgeWeight p ω e` of a configuration; for `p ∈ [0, 1]` the probability of `ω` under independent Bernoulli(`p`) coordinates.
nodes.title: Bernoulli product weight of a configuration

nodes.summary: Russo's formula, `deriv` form: `d/dp prob p A = ∑ e, pivotalProb p A e` for increasing `A`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: The weight of coordinate `e` in configuration `ω` with parameter `p`: `p` if `ω e` is open (`true`), `1 - p` otherwise.
nodes.title: Bernoulli weight of a single coordinate

nodes.summary: The derivative in `p` of the product weight (product rule).
nodes.title: Derivative of the configuration weight

nodes.summary: The derivative in `p` of a coordinate weight is `1` if the coordinate is open, `-1` otherwise.
nodes.title: Derivative of a single coordinate weight

nodes.summary: Russo's formula (Russo 1981; Margulis 1974): for an increasing event `A` on a finite set of coordinates, `p ↦ prob p A` has derivative `∑ e, pivotalProb p A e` at every `p`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: The derivative in `p` of `prob p A`, before grouping by pivotal coordinates.
nodes.title: Derivative of the event weight before grouping

nodes.summary: Pivotality with the two sides swapped.
nodes.title: Symmetric form of pivotality

nodes.summary: Pivotality of `e` depends only on the values of `ω` off `e`.
nodes.title: Pivotality depends only on the other coordinates

nodes.summary: For an increasing event `A`, the coordinate `e` is pivotal at `ω` iff `setClosed e ω ∉ A` and `setOpen e ω ∈ A`.
nodes.title: Pivotal coordinates of an increasing event

nodes.summary: Closing `e` does not change whether `e` is pivotal.
nodes.title: Closing a coordinate preserves its pivotality

nodes.summary: Opening `e` does not change whether `e` is pivotal.
nodes.title: Opening a coordinate preserves its pivotality

nodes.summary: The coordinate `e` is *pivotal* for the event `A` at `ω` if exactly one of `setOpen e ω` and `setClosed e ω` lies in `A`. The condition does not depend on `ω e`.
nodes.title: Pivotal coordinate for an event

nodes.summary: The pivotal weight `pivotalProb p A e` is nonnegative for `p ∈ [0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the pivotal weight

nodes.summary: The weight of the event that coordinate `e` is pivotal for `A`.
nodes.title: Weight of the event that a coordinate is pivotal

nodes.summary: `prob` is `StatMech.wprob` for Bernoulli coordinate weights.
nodes.title: Event weight as a product-weight probability

nodes.summary: The weight `∑ ω ∈ A, configWeight p ω` of an event `A`; for `p ∈ [0, 1]` its probability under independent Bernoulli(`p`) coordinates.
nodes.title: Bernoulli weight of an event

nodes.summary: The contribution of coordinate `e` to the derivative of `prob p A` is `pivotalProb p A e`, for increasing `A`.
nodes.title: Contribution of one coordinate to Russo's formula

nodes.summary: Russo's formula on one fiber `{ωt, ωf}` of configurations differing only at `e`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula on a single fiber

nodes.summary: `setClosed e ω` depends only on the values of `ω` off `e`.
nodes.title: Closing a coordinate depends only on the other coordinates

nodes.summary: Closing a coordinate gives a smaller configuration than opening it.
nodes.title: Closed configuration lies below the opened one

nodes.summary: Closing `e` in the configuration with value `b` at `e` and `η` elsewhere.
nodes.title: Closing a coordinate of a split configuration

nodes.summary: `setClosed e ω` is `ω` with coordinate `e` set to `false` (closed).
nodes.title: Closing a coordinate of a configuration

nodes.summary: `setOpen e ω` depends only on the values of `ω` off `e`.
nodes.title: Opening a coordinate depends only on the other coordinates

nodes.summary: Opening `e` in the configuration with value `b` at `e` and `η` elsewhere.
nodes.title: Opening a coordinate of a split configuration

nodes.summary: `setOpen e ω` is `ω` with coordinate `e` set to `true` (open).
nodes.title: Opening a coordinate of a configuration

nodes.summary: `weightOff p e ω` depends only on the values of `ω` off `e`.
nodes.title: Off-coordinate weight depends only on the other coordinates

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
